newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average ended 25.34 points lower at 6,036.46 on Wednesday after hitting four record highs last week.

** The Indonesian government on Wednesday stepped into the imbroglio surrounding the country's largest automobile maker, PT Astra International, saying it preferred that the company remain diversely held.

** The Jakarta Composite Index rose 3.60 points, or 0.63 percent, to close at 575.40 points on Wednesday on the back of active buying of some heavyweight stocks and secondaries despite a late wave of profit-taking in automobile manufacturer Astra International.
** On Thursday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,325.30/25.70 in early trading against an opening of 2,325.50/26.50.

** Astra and cigarette firm Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna on newspaper reports that PT Nusamba, led by Muhammad "Bob" Hasan, had bought a large Astra stake from Sampoerna founder and president director Putera Sampoerna.
** Bakrie & Brothers on reports an automobile unit of the conglomerate had signed a technical agreement with Singapore Technologies Logistics and PT Prosys Bangun Nusantara.
** Clothing company Great River on reports it had bought Ray Summers, a private Singapore-based company with a licence to distribute and sell Walt Disney Co's consumer products.
** Trading firm Rimba Niaga Idola on reports of a plan to acquire a majority stake in a Singapore-based food and baverage firm.
